name: refter
title: refter.io
payoff: Empower your team with intuitive data docs
shortDescription: refter simplifies data documentation for teams, focusing on user empowerment through intuitive interfaces and easy integration. It helps visualize data relationships, manage lifecycle changes, and promote knowledge sharing without requiring a credit card. An example use case is a company using refter to enhance their dbt project documentation, making it easier for data consumers to understand and utilize data effectively.
pros: Easy integration with existing dbt projects
No credit card required for setup
cons: May require technical knowledge for setup
